تغتنموا (form VIII)
# تَغْتَنِمُوا (taḡtanimū) /taɣ.ta.ni.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
# تُغْتَنَمُوا (tuḡtanamū) /tuɣ.ta.na.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَنَمَ (iḡtanama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
